T90-F-20261009. Implementation complete; commit 58a30b844 (one file). independent review: pending (G-class Critic and PO acceptance outstanding).

1. DoD results
- Baseline before any edit: passed. WSL whole file, exit 1, 157 tests, 150 pass, 1 fail (T90-T (f) only), 6 skipped (the win32-only pins).
- Ruling 111 behaviour: passed on native win32 for pins a, a2, b, c, d1, d2, e, f; (e), (f), (L) green under WSL.
- Native verify (T90-T): passed, exit 0, 8 pass, 1 skipped (L, typed reason: needs /proc).
- WSL whole file after the edit: passed, exit 0, 157 tests, 151 pass, 0 fail, 6 skipped; no failing case absent from the baseline.
- check-consumer-safe-paths.test.mjs: passed, exit 0, 9/9.
- Injectable seam: implemented; the default (real host) path is verified. The INJECTED path is not exercised by any existing test, so it is not verifiable here.
- One-file commit with exact trailers via git commit -F: passed (first attempt hit .git/index.lock, one retry succeeded).

2. Evidence
- evidence/T90-F-20261009/wsl-before.txt: wsl.exe -e bash -lc 'node plugins/pipeline-core/scripts/capture-evidence.mjs --out evidence/T90-F-20261009/wsl-before.txt --label wsl-before -- node --test plugins/pipeline-core/lib/human-guard-override.test.mjs', wrapped exit 1.
- evidence/T90-F-20261009/native.txt: node plugins/pipeline-core/scripts/capture-evidence.mjs --out evidence/T90-F-20261009/native.txt --label native -- node --test --test-name-pattern=T90-T plugins/pipeline-core/lib/human-guard-override.test.mjs, exit 0.
- evidence/T90-F-20261009/wsl-after.txt: same command as wsl-before with --label wsl-after, exit 0.
- node --test harness/scripts/check-consumer-safe-paths.test.mjs, exit 0 (console).

3. Changed files
- plugins/pipeline-core/lib/human-guard-override.mjs (commit 58a30b844): host seam (resolveAuditLockHost, dependencies.auditLockHost, keys platform, hostname, bootId, uptimeSeconds, nowMs, pidAlive; default = real host); win32 boot minute recorded in bootId (floor((now - uptime)/60000)); auditLockOwnerState split into linux (unchanged logic) and win32 (pid gone => dead; present pid with a boot minute differing by more than the tolerance => dead; else ambiguous; never live); typed error.recovery = { files, command } on both HGO-AUDIT-LOCK-AMBIGUOUS lock refusals (recovery guard and ordinary lock), messages unchanged.

4. Deliberately not changed
- The :2216 'audit lock host identity is unavailable' ambiguous throw (no lock file to name, so no typed recovery).
- appendAudit's genesis owner check and the :4404 caller run on the real host by design.
- Tests (QG-04); the stale WSL-skip text in the T90-T block is now outdated (test file, out of scope).
- The live HGO store and the live stale lock (PO attended action; not tested against the live store). The backlog item's triage text.

5. Deviations from spec
- Boot-time tolerance: Ruling 111 says a differing recorded boot time => dead; implemented as 'differs by MORE THAN one minute' (WIN32_BOOT_MINUTE_TOLERANCE = 1). Reason: now - uptime wobbles by up to about a second, so a live owner whose boot time sits near a minute edge could floor to an adjacent minute and be wrongly declared dead (stealing a held lock). Pin (c) plants '1' and (d1) plants the exact local value, so neither tests the boundary. Set the constant to 0 for the literal ruling; the Critic should rule.
- Seam key names differ from the briefing shorthand: actual { platform, hostname, bootId, uptimeSeconds, nowMs, pidAlive } under dependencies.auditLockHost.
- EPERM from the pid probe counts as pid present (ambiguous path); any other probe error => ambiguous.
- A malformed injected seam is refused with a new HGO-AUDIT-LOCK-MALFORMED path (not in the ruling).
- A record whose platform differs from the host platform is ambiguous on every host (test assumption 4; not stated by the ruling).
- The recovery command is platform-aware on the REAL platform (Remove-Item -LiteralPath on win32, rm -- elsewhere) and does not carry the 'confirm no ceremony is running' caveat; a consumer must render that.
- The 80% checkpoint fired at call 48; the remaining calls were commit and record only.

6. Open items
- independent review: pending (G class; Opus Critic dispatch is the Elephant's). resultSha256 left null.
- Next test-only slice (QG-04): re-pin (a)-(d) through dependencies.auditLockHost so they run on every host; add a boundary pin for the tolerance.
- The PO's live stale lock should now classify dead on the next acquisition (legacy bootId 'unavailable', pid gone) - untested live.
- Uncommitted artifacts: evidence/T90-F-20261009/{wsl-before,native,wsl-after}.txt, this record, scratch/commit-msg/T90-F-20261009.txt.
- Route pre-check: requested claude-sonnet-5-5 / xhigh, observed claude-sonnet-5-5 (runtime prompt), no contradiction.
